name: acute monoarthritis overview
title: Acute monoarthritis: one hot, red joint for under six weeks is infected until the aspirate says otherwise; the three C's (cell count, culture with Gram stain, crystals) separate septic arthritis from gout (needle-shaped, negatively birefringent urate) and pseudogout (rhomboid, positively birefringent calcium pyrophosphate), each with its own treatment

root.title: ONE hot, red, swollen joint for under 6 weeks: INFECTION until proven otherwise
lines: IF THE JOINT IS RED, ASPIRATE IT → the 3 C's: cell count (hours) · culture + Gram stain (24–48 h) · crystals (hours)
differential: infection · infection · infection · gout · pseudogout (rarely reactive or psoriatic arthritis)

groups.title: NO crystals, organisms seen or grown
CRYSTALS under polarized light
lines: both can look exactly like an infected joint, fever included

head: h
Septic arthritis
Staphylococcus 60%+ · streptococcus 20%
gram-negatives 15% (immunocompromised, elderly, intravenous (IV) drug use)
clue: red flags: fever · pain · range of motion ↓
• prosthetic joint or recent joint surgery
• IV drugs, alcohol, very young or old
inv: • Gram stain: e.g. Gram-positive cocci in clusters
• blood count, electrolytes, creatinine, C-reactive protein
tx: • a closed space: drain it, repeat until clean
• methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) risk: vancomycin + ceftriaxone

head: h
Gout
monosodium urate (uric acid) crystals
clue: • can't stand the bedsheet touching it
• SMARTS: surgery, mechanical injury, alcohol, recent illness, travel, starting or stopping allopurinol
inv: 2 · Uric acid may be NORMAL in an attack
• high uric acid alone ≠ gout: don't treat it
tx: • or prednisone 30 mg, down 5 mg every 2 days
• cover with an anti-inflammatory (NSAID) or colchicine

head: h
Pseudogout
calcium pyrophosphate (CPP) crystals
clue: Less intense, SLOWER to peak, lasts longer
days to a few weeks untreated
inv: CPP in cartilage: an X-ray finding, not the attack

panels.title: The cell count does not decide
items: the lecture's cases: septic 59 · gout 15 · pseudogout 18 (× 10⁹ cells/L), all inflammatory
Gram stain and culture find the infection · crystals split gout from pseudogout

panels.title: Gout: after the attack
items: less meat and seafood, less alcohol; vegetables and low-fat dairy are good
